name: Wick Editor
description: In the reviewed Wick Editor snapshot, the Electron main process calls electron-updater checkForUpdatesAndNotify at ready. Its builder config includes an afterSign notarization hook and hardened macOS settings; the checked Windows block specifies a target icon but does not establish released artifact signing or updater verification.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than original study checkout; release artifacts, generated manifests, Windows signing, and external electron-updater enforcement remain unverified.
